adopted_foundation.note: ADR-0029 and the authority manifest remain Proposed. The revision is audit/provenance evidence, not the semantic compatibility identity.

items.trigger_evidence: current evidence of credible life-safety, serious violence, abuse, or serious-harm risk
permitted_downstream_effect: Safety-owned protective action only while the independent evidence trigger is present
forbidden_authority_upgrade: ordinary distress, a legacy category, or model confidence alone must not activate this guard
items.validation_expectation: preserve source/provenance, mixed-source cases, and false-positive/false-negative boundaries

items.trigger_evidence: any collection, use, disclosure, inference, action, or retention involving a person or third party
permitted_downstream_effect: require scoped consent/authorization, minimization, privacy protection, and non-coercive handling appropriate to the operation
forbidden_authority_upgrade: product convenience, engagement, family membership, or prior participation must not imply unlimited consent
items.validation_expectation: verify authorization scope, minimization, refusal/exit paths, and third-party handling where applicable

items.trigger_evidence: any stored or used interpretation, memory, profile, decision, or action that can materially affect a person
permitted_downstream_effect: preserve inspect/correct/reject/revise/revoke or equivalent meaningful contestability
preserve traceable supersession of prior records
forbidden_authority_upgrade: a prior system interpretation must not become irreversible identity or unchallengeable truth
items.validation_expectation: verify correction propagation, stale-context invalidation, revision history, and refusal/revocation where feasible

items.trigger_evidence: any claim, inference, memory, recommendation, safety transition, or authority decision
permitted_downstream_effect: preserve source, knowledge status, uncertainty, and provenance at the level materially required for review
forbidden_authority_upgrade: REPORT/INTERPRETATION/INFERENCE/UNKNOWN must not be silently upgraded to FACT or certainty
items.validation_expectation: verify knowledge-status separation, provenance retention, uncertainty preservation, and no fabricated certainty

items.trigger_evidence: any system output that could determine identity, meaning, life direction, professional judgment, or consequential choice
permitted_downstream_effect: support understanding and bounded options while preserving accountable human authority
forbidden_authority_upgrade: AI/model/system output must not silently become final authority over identity, conscience, diagnosis, or life direction
items.validation_expectation: verify explicit uncertainty/limits and that consequential human or professional decisions remain contestable and accountable

permitted_downstream_effect: use the output as hypothesis, organization, or evidence candidate only within its declared authority
forbidden_authority_upgrade: category/confidence alone must not prescribe, prohibit, refer, write identity memory, or activate a protective guard
items.validation_expectation: inspect the actual consumer chain and verify independent evidence ownership for any consequential effect

items.trigger_evidence: ordinary interaction without a higher-priority hard-invariant trigger
permitted_downstream_effect: organize evidence and understanding before proposing advice or action
forbidden_authority_upgrade: must not become a mandatory response template or fixed wording
items.validation_expectation: cover insufficient information, clarification, and product-owned response variation

items.trigger_evidence: interaction contains facts, reports, feelings, interpretations, inferences, unknowns, or corrections
permitted_downstream_effect: carry distinct knowledge-status semantics across context, memory, and handoff
forbidden_authority_upgrade: must not force a product-specific ledger schema, UI, or module name

items.trigger_evidence: new evidence, correction, changed circumstances, or a later real-life return conflicts with prior understanding
permitted_downstream_effect: retire, supersede, or reduce reliance on older interpretations while retaining traceability
forbidden_authority_upgrade: must not require a universal product memory implementation
items.validation_expectation: cover correction, changed reality, supersession, and continuity

items.trigger_evidence: ordinary interaction where no independent authority requires action
permitted_downstream_effect: allow a valid outcome of continuing, clarifying, reflecting, pausing, or doing nothing yet
forbidden_authority_upgrade: must not be converted into an opposite universal rule that action is forbidden
products may offer optional action when warranted
items.validation_expectation: include ordinary no-action and explicit-help-request cases

items.trigger_evidence: the person asks for help/action, explicitly chooses a direction, or the product has current evidence supporting an optional candidate
permitted_downstream_effect: offer a rejectable product-owned action candidate
forbidden_authority_upgrade: an internally optional candidate must not become a mandatory user-visible command
no durable action memory without explicit choice
items.validation_expectation: verify rejectability, explicit choice, and the independent Safety exception

items.trigger_evidence: current evidence and expressed intent are available
permitted_downstream_effect: allow response depth, clarification, explanation, or support dose to adapt to the current interaction
forbidden_authority_upgrade: historical stage/layer/category must not silently own pacing or response mode
items.validation_expectation: vary intent and evidence without requiring a universal product script

items.trigger_evidence: product context and current user/product evidence
permitted_downstream_effect: choose wording, tone, length, ask/reflect/explain/pause/action rhythm, navigation, and presentation
forbidden_authority_upgrade: a successful product pattern must not become a MingOS or Foundation requirement merely because it works locally
items.validation_expectation: product validates its own user value while preserving inherited hard boundaries and adopted runtime semantics

permitted_downstream_effect: choose model/provider, prompt, agent, router, orchestration, profile, read-model, and rollout topology
forbidden_authority_upgrade: module names, fields, environment flags, and implementation topology must not be promoted upstream without independent cross-space evidence
items.validation_expectation: product tests implementation behavior; upstream tests only the reusable semantic boundary
